takes.title: Give Short Hand Signals and Reset
takes.actionDescription: From a staggered stance, the performer alternates bringing the hands in front of the chest with brief outward gestures. The hands lower to the sides between passages and at the end.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with a Deep Side Lean
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises one hand with the other near the hip, then folds to the side and returns to a neutral stance.

takes.title: Gesture Near the Head and Reach Outward
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with both hands near the head, pauses upright, and extends one arm across and upward. The arms lower at the end.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with a Side Point and Raised Hands
takes.actionDescription: The performer points sideways, lifts both hands beside the head, and moves one hand toward the forehead. The take ends upright with arms down.

takes.title: Alternate Overhead Reaches with Forward Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer lifts one arm overhead, folds forward with both hands in front, and resumes smaller gestures near the face. Both forearms remain raised in the final pose.

takes.title: Give Brief Signals from a Staggered Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises a hand to the chest and extends it outward during a short passage, with upright pauses before and after. The arms lower for the finish.

takes.title: Act Out a Teapot Rhyme with a Shoulder-Height Hand Lift
takes.actionDescription: The performer crosses a forearm in front of the chest, then repeatedly raises one hand with the other at the hip. They return to an upright stance.

takes.title: Lift Both Arms Overhead and Reach Low
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, alternates small hand gestures with reaching overhead, and bends to extend a hand lower. They finish upright with arms down.

takes.title: Act Out a Rhyme with Open Palms and a Forward Fold
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens both hands, brings them beside and behind the head, then folds forward. The take ends standing with arms lowered.

takes.title: Repeat Small Hand Motions with Upright Pauses
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates chest- and face-level gestures with periods of lowered arms, then reaches low to one side. They return to standing with arms lowered.

takes.title: Alternate Forward Reaches and Face-Level Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts still, extends and gathers the hands through several repetitions, and adds a forward lean. The take ends upright with both arms lowered.

takes.title: Mime a Prairie Dog with Small Hand Lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeats small hand motions near the face while shifting weight, then lowers the arms and stands straight.

takes.title: Mime a Whale with Overhead Arms and Forward Folds
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both arms, alternates overhead reaches with deep forward folds, and ends bent forward with both arms swept back.

takes.title: Mime a Bear with Raised Elbows and Bent-Knee Dips
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates raising both elbows with bent-knee forward dips and low arm motions. The final pose remains slightly crouched.

takes.title: Mime a Dog with Repeated Small Crouches
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly leans and dips with the elbows bent and hands near the torso, then stands upright at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Cat with Hand Lifts Beside the Head
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises the hands beside the head, alternates sideways or forward leans, and finishes in a shallow forward bend with arms low.

takes.title: Mime an Elephant with High Reaches and a Deep Bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly rounds the arms near or above the head, makes a deep forward fold midway, and straightens to finish.

takes.title: Mime a Mouse with Hands Held Close to the Face
takes.actionDescription: The performer keeps both hands near the mouth and makes small bends and weight shifts, remaining hands-up through the final frame.

takes.title: Mime a Chicken with Elbow Lifts and a Forward Dip
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates hands raised near the shoulders with a short forward dip, then returns upright with both elbows bent.

takes.title: Mime a Snake with Interlaced Forward Arm Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer gathers both arms near the chest, extends them forward during a slight lean, and lifts a hand before pulling both arms back in.

takes.title: Mime a Dinosaur with One Arm Raised High
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates raising an arm above the head with bent-elbow gestures and a forward dip. The hand lowers toward the chest at the end.

takes.title: Mime a Monkey with Side Bends and Wide Arm Sweeps
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through repeated side and forward leans with alternating high and low arm reaches. The final pose keeps one arm curved overhead.
